All testable anatomical checkpoints (rind, flesh, seed cavity, radial seeds) are visually present and biologically plausible. The inference of the cylindrical shape from slices is logically sound. The Router's detection of 'waxy/plastic' texture on the yellow vegetables is correct and indicative of synthetic generation. The edge bleeding noted by the Router is minor (severity 1.0) but contributes to a lack of perfect photorealism. The topology auditor's high mask confidence (0.934) confirms good object cohesion, but the subtle shadow inconsistencies and texture anomalies prevent a perfect artifact score. It is significantly better than the 'mid' reference (hammerhead, artifact 3.0) due to fewer structural deformations, but not quite 'high' reference quality (bird, artifact 4.0) due to the texture issues.
